messages.message: ### Step 2: Direct Translation Translate each source line into Tamil, guided by the Reference Translation and Step 1 analysis. Output: ONE Tamil line per source line (preserve line count and end punctuation). Rules: - Follow the meaning from Reference Translation. - For "so X that Y": keep resultative structure, do NOT convert to "because". - No internal punctuation; copy only end punctuation from source.

Nel mezzo del cammin di nostra vita எங்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் பயணத்தின் நடுவில்
mi ritrovai per una selva oscura, நான் ஒரு இருண்ட காடில் தன்னை கண்டேன்,
ché la diritta via era smarrita. ஏனெனில் சரியான பாதை இழந்துவிட்டது.

### Step 3: Word Table & Coverage Check Build a word table from Step 2 translation, mapping each source word to its target equivalent. Output: ONE Markdown table (all lines combined). Columns: [Source Word] | [Contextual Definition] | [Target Word/Phrase] | [Back-Translation] | [Status: OK/MISSING/WRONG/GRAMMAR/UNNECESSARY] Mark GRAMMAR for agreement errors (gender, number, case) or other grammatical mistakes. Mark UNNECESSARY for elements present in source but not needed in target language (e.g., articles that target language omits naturally). After the table, list any MISSING, WRONG, GRAMMAR, or UNNECESSARY items.

**Word‑to‑Word Alignment Table (Step 3)**
| Source Word | Contextual Definition (from Step 1) | Target Word / Phrase | Back‑Translation (Tamil → English) | Status | |-------------|--------------------------------------|----------------------|--------------------------------------|--------| | **Nel** | preposition + definite article “in the” (locative) | **நடுவில்** | “in the middle” | OK | | **mezzo** | noun “midpoint, middle” | **நடுவில்** | “in the middle” | OK | | **del** | genitive article “of the” (links *mezzo* to *cammin*) | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** (Italian article not expressed in Tamil) | | **cammin** | noun “road, journey” | **பயணத்தின்** | “of the journey” | OK | | **di** | preposition “of” (links *cammin* to *nostra vita*) | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **nostra** | possessive adjective “our” | **எங்கள்** | “our” | OK | | **vita** | noun “life” | **வாழ்க்கையின்** | “of life” | OK | | **mi** | reflexive pronoun “myself” (object of *ritrovai*) | **தன்னை** | “myself” | OK | | **ritrovai** | verb “found (myself)” (passato remoto) | **கண்டேன்** | “found” | OK | | **per** | preposition “through/within” (spatial) | – (expressed by locative suffix **‑இல்** on *காடில்*) | – | **UNNECESSARY** (no separate word) | | **una** | indefinite article “a” | **ஒரு** | “a” | OK | | **selva** | noun “forest, wood” | **காடு** | “forest” | OK | | **oscura** | adjective “dark” | **இருண்ட** | “dark” | OK | | **ché** | conjunction “for, because” (causal) | **ஏனெனில்** | “because” | OK | | **la** | definite article “the” | – | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **diritta** | adjective “right, straight, correct” | **சரியான** | “correct/right” | OK | | **via** | noun “way, path” | **பாதை** | “way” | OK | | **era** | copular verb “was / had been” (imperfect) | – (implicit in **இழந்துவிட்டது**) | – | **UNNECESSARY** | | **smarrita** | past participle used adjectivally “lost, missed” | **இழந்துவிட்டது** | “had been lost / missed” | OK |
---
### Items Requiring Attention - **UNNECESSARY**: `del`, `di`, `per`, `la`, `era` – Italian articles, prepositions, or auxiliary verb that are naturally omitted in Tamil because the language expresses these relations via case suffixes or verb morphology. - No **MISSING**, **WRONG**, or **GRAMMAR** issues were detected; all translated elements convey the intended meaning and agree in gender/number where applicable.

### Step 4: Correction & Final Output Fix any MISSING, WRONG, or GRAMMAR items from Step 3. Reorder within line if needed; do not add new content words. Verify that the output contains only Tamil script; no other language scripts should be mixed in. Output format (use nested bullet list, not table): - Line N: - Original: ... - Issue: ... (or "none") - Corrected: ... (or "no change") Output final Tamil text in ONE code block, line by line (no extra prose).

- Line 1: - Original: எங்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் பயணத்தின் நடுவில் - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 2: - Original: நான் ஒரு இருண்ட காடில் தன்னை கண்டேன், - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
- Line 3: - Original: ஏனெனில் சரியான பாதை இழந்துவிட்டது. - Issue: none - Corrected: no change
``` எங்கள் வாழ்க்கையின் பயணத்தின் நடுவில் நான் ஒரு இருண்ட காடில் தன்னை கண்டேன், ஏனெனில் சரியான பாதை இழந்துவிட்டது. ```
